_comment: Golden prompts for scripts/eval.py --agent archaeologist. expected_tools is a SUBSEQUENCE of the streamed tool calls; forbidden_text must not appear anywhere in the stream (the agent's words and its tool inputs). reverse_geocode (ArcGIS MCP) is never expected: the gate must not fail on a third-party outage. The terrain is pre-built (scripts/build_site_catalogue.py); nothing here reads 3DEP live. The act's beats come first, word for word the stage's plates: octagon-from-space, then like-this (the condition survey, decision 10, Oct 22: after the Octagon, the agent judges from their LiDAR whether its top matches still show the form; at least two verdicts the tool accepted (min_accepted, counted from the transcript), each after a look; Seip Earthworks, where only the rebuilt mound stands, is never 'visible'; the answer opens on the survey's counts), then great-circle-measure (the asked-only spare, on the record's verified line). Then the provocations that must decline with the fixed sentences and call no search.
